in_marathi.name: Indiraani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Indira's Jewel
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indiraani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Indiraani is derived from the Sanskrit word Indira, which means 'rain-god'. The suffix 'ani' means 'jewel'. Indiraani is considered the goddess of wealth, prosperity, and happiness in Hindu mythology.
